title: SCILLA PASSIVE: Cue-Driven Opportunistic Maritime Verification Using Non-Cooperative Merchant-Radar Illumination
description: Reproducible research release evaluating cue-driven opportunistic passive maritime second observations using moving non-cooperative merchant-radar illuminators. The release includes a classical EKF baseline, paired simulations, physics and integrity stress grids, preserved failure cases, source code and evidence ledgers. No measured RF performance, operational detection range, patentability, customer traction or acquisition interest is claimed.
